title: Protocol Pack
description: A jurisdiction's emergency call-intake playbook, expressed as a decision tree with per-locale string catalogs. Protocol logic is language-neutral; every caller-facing utterance is a stringId resolved against the catalog for the active locale.

provenance.description: Where this playbook's content came from and under what license it may be redistributed. Packs without redistribution rights must not be published in the public corpus.

caseEntry.description: Universal intake questions asked on every call, in order, before a protocol is selected.

fallbackProtocol.description: Protocol id used when the chief complaint matches no protocol's keywords.

strings.description: Per-locale catalogs: stringId -> template, or an array of equivalent template variants (a persona picks one, seeded). Templates may interpolate collected slots as {slotName}. The 'greeting', 'closing', 'dispatch_confirm', and 'clarify' ids are required by the engine.

selectsProtocol.description: This answer is matched against protocol keywords to choose the protocol.

confirmStringId.description: Optional read-back template (interpolating this question's slot) that a persona may speak after the answer, e.g. "Okay, {address}."

extract.description: v0.2: structurally extract the first number in the answer as this slot's numeric value, enabling numeric determinant/edge conditions (e.g. age > 35).

next.description: Conditional edges evaluated after this question is answered. If absent, flow continues to the next question in sequence.

whenOption.description: Take this edge when this question's answered option id matches. An edge with neither whenOption nor when is the default.

when.description: v0.2: additional conditions on previously collected slots (choice options or numeric comparisons); all must hold. Edges are evaluated in order.

goto.description: A question id within the same protocol, or the sentinel '$determine' to proceed to determinant selection.

gotoProtocol.description: v0.2: jump to another protocol's key questions ('go to the C1 card'). The target protocol takes over the rest of the call, including determinants.

option.description: Matches when the slot's answered option id equals this.

condition.description: Choice condition ({slot, option}) or numeric condition ({slot, gt/gte/lt/lte}) on a slot whose question declares extract: 'number'. A numeric condition never matches when no number was captured.

determinants.description: Ordered rules; the first whose conditions all match wins. The final rule should omit 'when' as a default.

response.description: Neutral response level, e.g. BLS_COLD, ALS_COLD, ALS_HOT.

postDispatch.description: stringIds of instructions read to the caller after responders are dispatched.
